description: Parsing of incoming timeout policy and custom health check inside group resolution. When incoming permissions are enabled and a node supplies incoming settings, the resolved group carries the parsed incoming timeout policy (response and idle timeouts given as duration strings such as '777s' or '13.33s') and the parsed health-check definition (path and cluster name). Output reports the group summary including the parsed response/idle timeouts and the health-check path and cluster.

cases.expected_output:
type=AllServicesGroup
mode=ADS
serviceName=
deps=[*]
incoming.permissionsEnabled=false
incoming.endpoints=[]
incoming.healthCheck.path=
incoming.healthCheck.cluster=local_service_health_check
incoming.timeout.response=777s
incoming.timeout.idle=13.330s

type=AllServicesGroup
mode=ADS
serviceName=
deps=[*]
incoming.permissionsEnabled=true
incoming.endpoints=[/endpoint|PATH|methods=[]|clients=[client1]]
incoming.healthCheck.path=/status/ping
incoming.healthCheck.cluster=local_service_health_check
incoming.timeout.response=none
incoming.timeout.idle=none
